tools.name: search_videos
tools.description: Search the public TurkishMeme catalog for Turkish and global video memes by title, remembered Turkish quote, person or scene, for example Fatih Terim or Kemal Sunal. Returns up to 10 matching titles and permanent video page URLs. Returns an empty list when no match is found. No media downloads or archive listing.

tools.name: get_video_details
tools.description: Get public metadata, a short transcript excerpt and the permanent page link for one video ID returned by search_videos. Does not return media download URLs.
